objective.provenance: Locally defined normalized elliptical proxy using the paper-reported Pour scales 0.12 m and 1.5 rad; these are not author-recovered coefficients.

observation.provenance: EgoEngine Section 3.2.2 publishes only the broad categories hand state, object pose, and retargeted reference command. The exact fields, anchor encoding, timestamps, contact flags, and one-step command preview below are local engineering choices and are not claimed as author settings.

residual_action.provenance: One controlled local repair of the diagnosed normalized-action unit mismatch. The existing +/-0.05 rad safety limit is retained; only the normalized output mapping changes. EgoEngine does not publish this residual scale.

controlled_experiment.reference_endpoint20_state: Bitwise-equal to the CPU endpoint-20 boundary used by the frozen checkpoint validation; serialized artifact bytes may differ while all 362 state entries agree.

report.reason_for_layout: each world retains an independent packed contact and constraint buffer; no partial packed-buffer array copy is used

short_rollout.attribution_limit: independent sampled actions are the only configured input difference, but GPU atomic-order nondeterminism remains possible

action_contract.provenance: One controlled local repair of the diagnosed normalized-action unit mismatch. The existing +/-0.05 rad safety limit is retained; only the normalized output mapping changes. EgoEngine does not publish this residual scale.

controlled_experiment.reference_endpoint20_state: Bitwise-equal to the CPU endpoint-20 boundary used by the frozen checkpoint validation; serialized artifact bytes may differ while all 362 state entries agree.

logging_semantics.sampled_action_preclamp: stochastic action sampled from the PPO policy distribution before the official [-1,1] clamp; this is not actor mean mu
logging_semantics.sampled_action_clamped: the same sampled action after the official [-1,1] clamp
logging_semantics.applied_residual: bounded residual after local scale and formal safety clip
logging_semantics.actor_distribution_parameters: actor mean mu and policy standard deviation are not recorded by this schema
logging_semantics.contact_summary: control-endpoint hand-object finger flags; not substep collision topology
logging_semantics.write_timing: rollout samples are held in memory and written only at the next epoch boundary or after training completes
